statement: For unrestricted integer branches O(n)=floor(n^(3/2)) and E(n)=floor(n^(2/3)) on n>=0, E(O(n)) equals n at perfect squares and n-1 otherwise; O(E(n))<=n with equality exactly at perfect cubes. For the parity-selected modified Juggler map A095396, every actual OE pair has F(F(n))=n-1, and every actual EO pair from n>0 has F(F(n))<n, since parity excludes the respective equality cases. There is no positive two-cycle with two distinct elements. Written proof and exact regressions through n=10000 and at large perfect-power boundaries; no Lean coverage, originality claim, longer-cycle exclusion, or termination theorem.
